name: TEST_DemonstrationVampire
vampire_desc: A test vampire used to validate the JSON schema — do not use in actual gameplay.
mortal_self: Born in 1892 to a poor family in Dublin, worked as a bookbinder until the Great War. Survived the 1916 Easter Rising as a courier. Lost everything in the conflicts, died in a hospital during the flu pandemic of 1919.

memories.name: The Scholarly Curate
memories.description: A memory from the early 1900s when I served a small Anglican parish.
experiences: Discovered a leather-bound grimoire hidden behind a loose stone in the church crypt, dated 1347. The text was half-prayer, half-ritual instruction.
Used the grimoire's techniques to perform a minor healing that saved a child from pneumonia.
The local priest discovered my secret and begged me to never speak of it. I promised, but the knowledge changed me.

memories.name: The War Nurse
memories.description: A memory from the trenches of the Somme, 1916.
experiences: Met a Red Cross nurse named Clara who could see that I was not entirely human.
She held my hand during a gas attack and did not die — I had protected her.
She whispered, 'Thank you, monster,' which was either the cruelest or kindest thing anyone ever said to me.

memories.name: The First Hunger
memories.description: When I first realized what I had become.
experiences: Three weeks after waking in the morgue, the thirst overtook me.
I took my first life — a vagrant found near the Thames, already dying of exposure. I told myself he chose this.
The blood warmed something inside me that I feared had died with me. I hated and loved it equally.
Discovered a leather-bound grimoire hidden behind a loose stone in the church crypt, dated 1347.
Used the grimoire's techniques to perform a minor healing that saved a child from pneumonia.

skills.name: Bloodthirsty
skills.description: Gained my first taste of mortal suffering.

skills.name: Churchcraft
skills.description: Knowledge of the grimoire's rituals and their effects.

skills.name: Trench Medicine
skills.description: Learned from Clara during the war. Still partially effective.

resources.name: The Black Grimoire
resources.description: The ancient book from the church crypt. Bound in black leather, pages feel warm.

resources.name: Silver Reliquary
resources.description: A small silver box containing a fragment of holy relic from Notre-Dame.

resources.name: Iron Cross
resources.description: Received for bravery in the trenches. Now useless — a reminder of the man I was.

characters.name: Clara Whitmore
characters.description: Red Cross nurse. Could see my true nature. Died in the 1919 flu pandemic along with my old self.
characters.death_reason: The influenza of 1919. She took my hand during the fever and did not die from it, but the virus claimed her anyway.

characters.name: Father Edward Hargrave
characters.description: The parish priest who discovered my secret. A kind man, terrified but not unkind.
characters.death_reason: Old age — he lived to ninety, never speaking of what he saw in the crypt.

characters.name: Silas Vorne
characters.description: A fellow newborn who turned me. Older by two centuries than I am now. Cold, calculating, and impatient.

characters.name: Lady Morwenna Ashworth
characters.description: A centuries-old vampire who has taken an interest in me. Wealthy, well-connected, and dangerous.

marks.name: Eternal Thirst
marks.description: My skin feels perpetually cold, as if winter's breath never leaves it.
marks.concealment: Always wear gloves and heavy clothes. No one questions a pale, cold person in London fog.

marks.name: The Morgue Wake
marks.description: My body was stolen from a public morgue. Anyone who knows the records could discover it.
marks.concealment: No one from that morgue is alive anymore.

journal.prompt_text: You wake in a cold, silent place. Your body is whole. You are not. What do you do?
journal.paraphrased_prompt: Waking as a newborn vampire — first moments of discovery.
journal.experience: The morgue drawer slid open with a screech of rusted metal. The air smelled of carbolic and decay. I stood on shaking legs and looked at my reflection in the steel countertop — pale, unaging, eyes like polished obsidian. I was dead. I knew this with the same certainty that I knew I was breathing. I was both.
journal.changes: Gained skill: First Hunger. Mark: Eternal Thirst.

journal.prompt_text: Silas Vorne appears at your door. He wants to train you. What is his price?
journal.paraphrased_prompt: The mentor vampire approaches — training comes at a cost.
journal.experience: Silas arrived not by knocking, but by simply being there when I turned. He stood in the shadows of my first flat, wearing a military uniform from a war three decades old. His smile was thin and hungry. 'You will learn,' he said. 'But learning is a two-way street. You will serve me in return.'
journal.changes: Gained skill: Churchcraft. Resource: The Black Grimoire.
